title: Vibrant Filipino Turkey Ham Lechon
description: A festive Filipino dish featuring turkey ham, served with a mother-sauce-base, this lechon is a low-sodium-friendly and flavorful meal option. It combines the bitterness of some ingredients with the shattering crunch of others.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together palm vinegar, fish sauce, lime juice, and black pepper to make the mother sauce.
Add the sliced turkey ham to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the turkey ham from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the remaining marinade over the turkey ham and sprinkle with minced garlic and chopped onion.
Place the bay leaves on top of the turkey ham and bake for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the turkey ham from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
